name: Downward-Closed Expansion Sequence
statement: A connected graph is a daisy cube exactly when it can be obtained from $K_1$ by a sequence of peripheral expansions whose duplicated sites are downward closed in the rooted coordinate order at each step.
hypotheses: Finite connected graph; each step uses the root and embedding carried by the construction.
comments: The survey calls these $\leq$-expansions. Requiring the duplicated site to be convex selects the median daisy cubes.
